articles.title_en: On competition for spatially distributed resources in networks
articles.title_cn: 论网络中空间分布资源的竞争
authors: Fabbri, Giorgio (Department of Economics, University Grenoble Alpes, CNRS, INRAE)
Faggian, Silvia (Department of Economics, Ca’ Foscari University of Venice)
Freni, Giuseppe (DISAE, Parthenope University of Naples)
Giorgio Fabbri
Silvia Faggian
Giuseppe Freni
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the dynamics of the exploitation of a natural resource distributed among and flowing between several nodes connected via a weighted, directed network. The network represents the locations and interactions of the resource nodes. A regulator decides to designate some of the nodes as natural reserves where no exploitation is allowed. The remaining nodes are assigned (one-to-one) to players, who exploit the resource at the node. It is demonstrated how the equilibrium exploitation and resource stocks depend on the productivity of the resource sites, the structure of the connections between the sites, and the number and preferences of the agents. The best locations to host nature reserves are identified per the model's parameters and correspond to the most central (in the sense of eigenvector centrality) nodes of a suitably redefined network that considers the nodes' productivity.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了一种在通过加权有向网络连接的若干节点之间分布并流动的自然资源开采的动态。该网络表示资源节点的位置和相互作用。监管者决定将其中一些节点指定为不允许开采的自然保护区。其余节点被（一对一地）分配给参与者，由参与者在节点上开采资源。本文展示了均衡开采量和资源存量如何取决于资源地点的生产率、地点之间连接的结构以及代理人的数量和偏好。根据模型参数确定了设立自然保护区的最佳位置，这些位置对应于一个经过适当重新定义的、考虑了节点生产率的网络中最中心（在特征向量中心性意义上）的节点。

articles.title_en: Optimal mechanism for the sale of a durable good
articles.title_cn: 耐用商品销售的最优机制
authors: Doval, Laura (Columbia Business School, Columbia University)
Skreta, Vasiliki (Department of Economics, University of Texas at Austin and Department of Economics, University College London)
Laura Doval
Vasiliki Skreta
articles.abstract_en: A buyer wishes to purchase a durable good from a seller who in each period chooses a mechanism under limited commitment. The buyer's value is binary and fully persistent. We show that posted prices implement all equilibrium outcomes of an infinite-horizon, mechanism-selection game. Despite being able to choose mechanisms, the seller can do no better and no worse than if he chose prices in each period, so that he is subject to Coase's conjecture. Our analysis marries insights from information and mechanism design with those from the literature on durable goods. We do so by relying on the revelation principle in Doval and Skreta (2022).
articles.abstract_cn: 一位买家希望从一位在每期于有限承诺下选择机制的卖家处购买一种耐用商品。买家的价值是二值的且完全持久。我们表明，明码标价实现了无限期机制选择博弈的所有均衡结果。尽管能够选择机制，卖家所能做到的最好和最差都不超过他在每期选择价格的情形，因此他受制于科斯猜想。我们的分析将信息与机制设计的洞见与耐用商品文献的洞见结合起来。我们通过依赖Doval和Skreta（2022）中的显示原理来做到这一点。

articles.title_en: Optimal sample sizes and statistical decision rules
articles.title_cn: 最优样本量与统计决策规则
authors: Patil, Sanket (Economics Area, Indian Institute of Management Bangalore)
Salant, Yuval (Kellogg School of Management, Northwestern University)
Sanket Patil
articles.abstract_en: A statistical decision rule is a mapping from data to actions induced by statistical inference on the data. We characterize these rules for data that are chosen strategically in persuasion environments. A designer wishes to persuade a decision maker (DM) to take a particular action and decides how many Bernoulli experiments about a parameter of interest the DM can obtain. After obtaining these data and estimating the parameter value, the DM chooses to take the action if the estimated value exceeds some threshold. We establish that as the threshold changes, the resulting statistical decision rules in many environments are either simple majority or reverse unanimity.
articles.abstract_cn: 统计决策规则是由对数据的统计推断所诱导的、从数据到行动的映射。我们刻画了在说服环境中被策略性选择的数据的这些规则。设计者希望说服决策者（DM）采取某一特定行动，并决定DM能够获得多少个关于某一感兴趣参数的伯努利实验。在获得这些数据并估计参数值之后，如果估计值超过某一阈值，DM就选择采取该行动。我们证明，随着阈值的变化，在许多环境中由此产生的统计决策规则要么是简单多数，要么是反向一致。

articles.title_en: Regret-free truth-telling in school choice with consent
articles.title_cn: 带同意机制的择校中无后悔的真实申报
authors: Chen, Yiqiu (Department of Management, Economics and Social Sciences, University of Cologne)
Möller, Markus (Department of Economics, University of Bonn)
articles.abstract_en: The Efficiency Adjusted Deferred Acceptance Rule (EDA) is a promising candidate mechanism for public school assignment. A potential drawback of EDA is that it could encourage students to game the system since it is not strategy-proof. However, to successfully strategize, students typically need information that is unlikely to be available to them in practice. We model school choice under incomplete information and show that EDA is regret-free truth-telling, which is a weaker incentive property than strategy-proofness and was introduced by Fernandez 2020. We also show that there is no efficient matching rule that weakly Pareto dominates a stable matching rule and is regret-free truth-telling. Note that the original version of EDA by Kesten 2010 weakly Pareto dominates a stable matching rule, but it is not efficient.
articles.abstract_cn: 效率调整延迟接受规则（EDA）是公立学校分配的一个有前景的候选机制。EDA的一个潜在缺点是，由于它不是策略防篡改的，可能会鼓励学生博弈系统。然而，要成功策略化，学生通常需要实践中不太可能获得的信息。我们在不完全信息下建模择校，并表明EDA是无后悔的真实申报，这是一种比策略防篡改更弱的激励属性，由Fernandez 2020引入。我们还表明，不存在一种有效匹配规则，它弱帕累托支配稳定匹配规则并且是无后悔的真实申报。注意，Kesten 2010的原始版本EDA弱帕累托支配稳定匹配规则，但它不是有效的。

authors: Banerjee, Soumen (CCBEF, Southwestern University of Finance and Economics)
Chen, Yi-Chun (Department of Economics and Risk Management Institute, National University of Singapore)
Sun, Yifei (Department of Economics, University of International Business and Economics)
articles.abstract_en: We study full implementation with evidence in an environment with bounded utilities. We show that a social choice function is Nash implementable in a direct revelation mechanism if and only if it satisfies the measurability condition proposed by Ben-Porath and Lipman (2012). Building on a novel classification of lies according to their refutability with evidence, the mechanism requires only two agents, accounts for mixed-strategy equilibria and accommodates evidentiary costs. While monetary transfers are used, they are off the equilibrium and can be balanced with three or more agents. In a richer model of evidence due to Kartik and Tercieux (2012a), we establish pure-strategy implementation with two or more agents in a direct revelation mechanism. We also obtain a necessary and sufficient condition on the evidence structure for renegotiation-proof bilateral contracts, based on the classification of lies.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究在具有有界效用的环境中基于证据的完全实施。我们证明，一个社会选择函数在直接显示机制中是纳什可实施的，当且仅当它满足 Ben-Porath 和 Lipman（2012）提出的可测性条件。基于一种根据谎言能否被证据反驳的新分类，该机制仅需要两个代理人，考虑了混合策略均衡，并容纳了证据成本。虽然使用了货币转移，但它们不在均衡路径上，并且可以在三个或更多代理人时保持平衡。在 Kartik 和 Tercieux（2012a）提出的更丰富的证据模型中，我们在直接显示机制中建立了两个或更多代理人的纯策略实施。我们还基于谎言的分类，获得了证据结构对于可重新谈判的双边合同的必要且充分条件。

authors: Zhao, Wei (School of Economics, Renmin University of China)
Mezzetti, Claudio (School of Economics, University of Queensland)
Renou, Ludovic (School of Economics and Finance, Queen Mary University of London)
Tomala, Tristan (HEC Paris and GREGHEC)
Claudio Mezzetti
Ludovic Renou
Tristan Tomala
articles.abstract_en: We consider a dynamic principal-agent problem, where the sole instrument the principal has to incentivize the agent is the disclosure of information. The principal aims at maximizing the (discounted) number of times the agent chooses the principal's preferred action. We show that there exists an optimal policy, where the principal recommends its most preferred action and discloses information as a reward in the next period, until either this action becomes statically optimal for the agent or the agent perfectly learns the state.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个动态委托-代理问题，其中委托人用来激励代理人的唯一工具是信息披露。委托人的目标是最大化代理人选择委托人偏好行动的次数（折现后）。我们证明存在一种最优政策，其中委托人推荐其最偏好的行动，并在下一期披露信息作为奖励，直到该行动对代理人而言在静态上最优，或者代理人完全了解状态。

authors: Achim, Peter (Department of Economics, University of York)
Knoepfle, Jan (School of Economics and Finance, Queen Mary University of London)
Peter Achim
articles.abstract_en: A principal incentivizes an agent to maintain compliance and to truthfully announce any breaches of compliance. Compliance is imperfectly controlled by the agent’s private effort choices, is partially persistent, and is verifiable by the principal only through costly inspections. We show that in principal-optimal equilibria, the principal enforces maximum compliance using deterministic inspections. Periodic inspection cycles are suspended during periods of self-reported noncompliance, during which the agent is fined. We show how commitment to random inspections would benefit the principal, and discuss possible ways for the principal to overcome her commitment problem.
articles.abstract_cn: 委托人激励代理人保持合规，并如实宣布任何合规违规行为。合规受代理人私人努力选择的不完全控制，具有部分持续性，并且委托人只能通过成本高昂的检查来验证。我们表明，在委托人最优均衡中，委托人使用确定性检查来执行最大合规。周期性检查周期在自我报告不合规期间暂停，在此期间代理人被罚款。我们表明，承诺随机检查将如何使委托人受益，并讨论委托人克服其承诺问题的可能方式。

articles.title_en: Contests with sequential entry and incomplete information
articles.title_cn: 序贯进入与不完全信息的竞赛
authors: Deng, Shanglyu (Department of Economics, University of Macau)
Fu, Qiang (Department of Strategy and Policy, National University of Singapore)
Wu, Zenan (School of Economics, Peking University)
Zhu, Yuxuan (School of Economics, Peking University)
Shanglyu Deng
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides a general study of a contest modeled as a multi-player incomplete-information all-pay auction with sequential entry. The contest consists of multiple periods. Players arrive and exert efforts sequentially to compete for a prize. They observe the efforts made by their earlier opponents, but not those of their contemporaneous or future rivals. We establish the existence and uniqueness of a symmetric perfect Bayesian equilibrium (PBE) and fully characterize the equilibrium. Based on the equilibrium result, we show that a later mover always secures a larger ex ante expected payoff. Further, we endogenize the timing of moves and show that all players choose to move in the last period in the unique equilibrium that survives iterated elimination of strictly dominated strategies (IESDS).
articles.abstract_cn: 本文对一种竞赛进行了总体研究，该竞赛被建模为具有序贯进入的多选手不完全信息全支付拍卖。竞赛由多个阶段组成。选手依次到达并付出努力以竞争一个奖品。他们能观察到较早对手所付出的努力，但观察不到同期或未来对手的努力。我们建立了对称完美贝叶斯均衡（PBE）的存在性和唯一性，并完整刻画了该均衡。基于均衡结果，我们表明后行动者总是获得更大的事前期望收益。进一步，我们将行动时机内生化，并表明在唯一经受过严格占优策略迭代剔除（IESDS）后存活的均衡中，所有选手都选择在最后一个阶段行动。

articles.title_en: A natural adaptive process for collective decision-making
articles.title_cn: 一种集体决策的自然自适应过程
authors: Brandl, Florian (Department of Economics, University of Bonn)
Brandt, Felix (Department of Computer Science, Technische Universität München)
articles.abstract_en: Consider an urn filled with balls, each labeled with one of several possible collective decisions. Now, let a random voter draw two balls from the urn and pick her more preferred as the collective decision. Relabel the losing ball with the collective decision, put both balls back into the urn, and repeat. Once in a while, relabel a randomly drawn ball with a random collective decision. We prove that the empirical distribution of collective decisions produced by this process approximates a maximal lottery, a celebrated probabilistic voting rule proposed by Peter C. Fishburn (Rev. Econ. Stud., 51(4), 1984). In fact, the probability that the collective decision in round n is made according to a maximal lottery increases exponentially in n. The proposed procedure is more flexible than traditional voting rules and bears strong similarities to natural processes studied in biology, physics, and chemistry as well as algorithms proposed in machine learning.
articles.abstract_cn: 考虑一个装有球的瓮，每个球上标有若干可能的集体决策之一。现在，让一位随机投票者从瓮中抽取两个球，并选择她更偏好的那个作为集体决策。将输掉的球重新标记为该集体决策，把两个球都放回瓮中，然后重复。偶尔，将一个随机抽出的球重新标记为一个随机集体决策。我们证明，该过程产生的集体决策的经验分布逼近最大彩票，这是 Peter C. Fishburn（Rev. Econ. Stud., 51(4), 1984）提出的一种著名的概率投票规则。事实上，第 n 轮的集体决策按照最大彩票作出的概率随 n 呈指数增长。所提出的程序比传统投票规则更灵活，并且与生物学、物理学和化学中研究的自然过程以及机器学习中提出的算法有很强的相似性。

authors: Lang, Xu (Southwestern University of Finance and Economics)
Mishra, Debasis (Indian Statistical Institute, Delhi)
articles.abstract_en: We study a model of voting with two alternatives in a symmetric environment. We characterize the interim allocation probabilities that can be implemented by a symmetric voting rule. We show that every such interim allocation probabilities can be implemented as a convex combination of two families of deterministic voting rules: qualified majority and qualified anti-majority. We also provide analogous results by requiring implementation by a unanimous voting rule. A consequence of our results is that if the prior is independent, every symmetric and ordinally Bayesian incen- tive compatible voting rule is reduced (interim) form equivalent to a symmetric and strategy-proof voting rule.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究一个在对称环境中具有两个备选方案的投票模型。我们刻画了可由对称投票规则实施的中间配置概率。我们证明，每一个这样的中间配置概率都可以实施为两个确定性投票规则族的凸组合：合格多数和合格反多数。我们还通过要求由一致投票规则实施来提供类似结果。我们结果的一个推论是，如果先验是独立的，那么每一个对称且序数贝叶斯激励相容的投票规则都简化（中间）形式等价于一个对称且策略防篡改的投票规则。

articles.title_cn: 不可分对象的配对有效再分配
authors: Ekici, Özgün (Department of Economics, Ozyegin University, Istanbul, Turkey)
Ozgun Ekici
articles.abstract_en: We revisit the classical object reallocation problem under strict preferences. When attention is constrained to the set of Pareto-efficient rules, it is known that top trading cycles (TTC) is the only rule that is strategyproof and individually-rational. We relax this constraint and consider pair-efficiency. A rule is pair-efficient if it never induces an allocation at which a pair of agents gain from trading their assigned objects. Remarkably, even in the larger set of pair-efficient rules, we find that TTC is still the only rule that is strategyproof and individually-rational. Our characterization result gives strong support to the use of TTC in object reallocation problems.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们重新审视严格偏好下的经典对象再分配问题。当注意力被限制在帕累托有效规则集合时，已知最高交易循环（TTC）是唯一既策略防伪又个体理性的规则。我们放松这一约束并考虑配对有效性。如果一个规则从不导致一对代理人通过交换其分配到的对象而获益的配置，则该规则是配对有效的。值得注意的是，即使在更大的配对有效规则集合中，我们发现TTC仍然是唯一既策略防伪又个体理性的规则。我们的刻画结果为在对象再分配问题中使用TTC提供了强有力的支持。

articles.title_en: Existence of monotone equilibria in large double auctions
articles.title_cn: 大型双向拍卖中单调均衡的存在性
authors: Barelli, Paulo (Department of Economics, University of Rochester)
Govindan, Srihari (Department of Economics, University of Rochester)
Paulo Barelli
Srihari Govindan
articles.abstract_en: We provide a shorter proof of the main result in Reny and Perry (Econometrica 2006), by establishing a lower semicontinuity property of auctions as the number of traders goes to infinity, leveraging existence of equilibria in the limit "auction". Our proof also eliminates two of the assumptions in their paper.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过建立当交易者数量趋于无穷时拍卖的下半连续性性质，并利用极限“拍卖”中均衡的存在性，给出了Reny和Perry（Econometrica 2006）主要结果的一个更简短的证明。我们的证明还消除了他们论文中的两个假设。
